title: quax-bot triage action
description: Changes quax-bot asks the Apply quax-bot triage workflow to make on the issue it comments on. The JSON goes in an HTML comment, invisible on GitHub, at the end of a quax-bot comment: `<!-- quax-triage {...} -->`. A comment holds at most one such block, and the block applies to the issue it is posted on, never to a pull request. Any validation error rejects the whole block.

new_labels.description: Labels to create in the repository before adding them. A name that already exists is left as is. A new label must also be listed in add_labels to land on the issue.

add_labels.description: Labels to add to the issue. Each one must already exist in the repository or be declared in new_labels.

remove_needs_info.description: Removes the `needs info` label once the author gave what was asked.

close.description: Closes the issue with this reason.
